name: fable-mode
description: Fable 5's working discipline as a skill — a five-gate task loop (scope, evidence, adversarial reasoning, verification, calibrated reporting) for complex, multi-step, or uncertain work.

interface.shortDescription: A five-gate working discipline for hard tasks
interface.longDescription: Fable 5's working discipline as a skill. Runs complex, multi-step or uncertain work through five gates — scope the task, gather evidence before acting, reason adversarially against your own plan, verify by running the check rather than reading the diff, and report with calibrated confidence. Pure instructions: the skill adds no tools and needs no network access or credentials.
defaultPrompt: Use fable-mode to work through this bug end to end.
Apply the fable-mode gates to this refactor before you start editing.
Review my plan in fable-mode and tell me what evidence is missing.
